name: api_heygen_voice_1
title: HeyGen Voice 1.0: Voice Clone to Speech
summary: Clone a voice from a short recording with HeyGen Voice 1.0, then speak any script in that voice. Connect one audio clip to Instant Clone and the resulting voice_id feeds straight into text to speech, with no training wait. Use the expressiveness control to stay close to the recording or push more emotion into the delivery. Ideal for narration in your own voice, character dialogue, and multilingual voiceover.
